sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.37
- Enhanced Hardware Body Colors in Configurator Studio with image thumbnail previews and click-to-browse
- Added automatic dominant color sampling from chassis renders with manual hex override
- Added drag-and-drop reordering with grip handles and precision chevron controls
- Added resilient canvas rendering with fallback to base chassis render on 404/broken assets
